before.flag: The hiring media tour: every show, the same five minutes.
“You will become us, we won’t become you.” Sold as vision. It was a defense.
Players in the portal window saying they hadn’t heard from him.
The news stories about how vigorously he exercises.
Spotted at Crisler with his wife, shellshocked and out of their element. “RR, part 2.” Said it that night, too.
Urban is welcome at any practice but one.
Ohio State is just another game.
Big Ten media day. Asking how much longer the press conference would take.
